issues.description: Two getter methods for Lecture attributes are declared with private visibility in the solution but the exercise asks students to "Implement getters for each attribute" (i.e. public getters) and tests will expect to call them. Concretely: in solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java the methods getLectureName() (signature at line 22) and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() (signature at line 30) are declared private. The problem statement (part 2, "Implement Getters") instructs implementation of getters for every attribute and test names imply external access. This mismatch prevents external code/tests from accessing those attributes via the expected public getters and will cause student tests or example usage to fail or be confusing.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getters for all Lecture attributes public to match the exercise description and test expectations. Specifically change the declarations in solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java: change 'private String getLectureName()' to 'public String getLectureName()' and 'private int getNumberOfInscribedStudents()' to 'public int getNumberOfInscribedStudents()'. Ensure the template, solution, and any example/test code consistently use public getters.
